note: The early of the two shows the Dead played this night. Assembled disc by disc rather than by merge. Road Trips 3:3 spreads this night across four discs — disc one is the early show, discs two and three the late, and the bonus disc carries six more early-show songs plus two late-show ones — so a title-matching merge over the undivided night assigned several timings to the wrong sitting (the early Friend Of The Devil took the late show's 4:06, Cumberland Blues took 5:14, Cold Jordan took 2:33). Every duration here comes from the disc that actually holds that performance. The article's own setlists mark which songs are on the release (*) and which are on the bonus disc (**), and both sittings match those lists exactly. Every song here is on the release or its bonus disc, so no tape was needed. The Cryptical > Drums > The Other One > Cryptical run is folded into That's It for the Other One under the fold rule in data/CORRECTIONS.md — nothing but The Other One and Drums sits between the two Crypticals — and the release names it that way at 24:29, against the soundboard's undivided 24:26.
